text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired: PD-INC-2213 — alert: redis-saturation-eu (P1). Symptom: connection throttles / 5xx on inference-cache, spike started ~02:14 UTC. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-INC-2213 :rotating_light:

sasha: ack — I'm oncall and taking initial triage :eyes:

pagerduty: Incident assigned to sasha

nate: ping @sasha — I can jump in with infra creds, want me to take remediation?

sasha: pls, do the remediation runbook while I confirm customer impact and notify CS. I'll stay on thread for context.

nate: ack. quick checks:
```
$ curl -sS https://metrics.internal/services/inference-cache | jq '.errors.rate_5xx'
> 0.32
$ redis-cli -h redis-eu stats | grep connected_clients
> connected_clients: 1980
```
Looks like connections hit maxclients and client errors spiked.

kevin: i'm infra on-call, available to take ownership in ~7m if you want to hand off after the quick mitigations.

nate: taking initial fixes now: bumping app-side pool -> 200, scaling inference-cache replicas 3->5, and enabling short-lived connection pooling. Applying config:
```yaml
cache:connection_pool: 200
autoscale.replicas.min: 3
autoscale.replicas.max: 8
```
Rolling deploy started.

sasha: customer-impact note: CS flagged multiple EU enterprise customers seeing 25-40% failed requests; we're sending a PSAT.

nate: deploys rolled, piggybacked a sentinel reconfig to increase maxclients on masters. Watching metrics.

kevin: I ran `redis-cli CONFIG GET maxclients` and increased from 1000 to 4000 on the primaries, then rolled replicas. Also tightened client idle timeout for abusive connections.

nate: immediate effect: 5xx rate down 32% -> 9% in ~3m.  p95 latency trending down but still elevated.

kevin: taking over ownership for the stabilization window. @sasha handing off to me for follow-up and postmortem. I will monitor for 20m then update. :white_check_mark:

sasha: thanks @kevin and @nate. CS notified and tracking impacted customers. I'll open a post-incident customer update draft.

maya: filing followup ENG ticket ENG-3456 for root cause and long-term fixes (sharding + better connection backpressure). Assigning to eng-runtime + infra.

kevin: monitoring: replication lag normalized, error rate down to 3%, p95 back to baseline. No further connection errors reported.

nate: verification: synthetic traffic to EU endpoints showing success rate 99.5% over last 6m.

kevin: leaving a runbook note: temporary mitigation = bump maxclients + scale replicas + tighten client timeouts. Permanent actions: add per-tenant limits, smarter prefix hotpath, add KV cache sharding.

sasha: agreed. I'm adding postmortem owner and scheduling follow-up.

kevin: incident mitigated — stable for 12m. I'll mark resolved in PD in 10m if no regressions.

incidentbot: PagerDuty note: responder kevin acknowledged and took ownership at 02:22 UTC.

kevin: closing: metrics stable for 20m, customer failures resolved. Root cause: sudden hotspot + connection exhaustion. Follow-up ENG-3456 created. Closing the incident now. :heavy_check_mark:

sasha: thanks everyone. Good coordination. :thumbsup:
